fs: late Hauterivian (Warlingham 1488/7; re-recorded as CfA Hauterivian-colthick by Hughes et al. 1991)
ls: late Hauterivian (Warlingham 1488/7; re-recorded as CfA Hauterivian-colthick by Hughes et al. 1991)

muller.region: English Upper Wealden, Warlingham Borehole 1488/7 ft (preparation V957)
muller.full: Hughes, N. F. 1977. Palaeo-succession of earliest angiosperm evolution. Botanical Review 43: 105-127.
muller.note: In 1977 Hughes left these grains unnamed and called them presumed Barremian; his later correlation (Hughes & McDougall 1990) moved the lower Warlingham samples into the late Hauterivian, and Hughes, McDougall & Chapman (1991) re-recorded this very grain as CfA Hauterivian-colthick. The tree dates Clavatipollenites and Retimonocolpites to about 135 Ma, most likely from the Valanginian-Hauterivian records of Israel (Brenner 1996) and Italy (Trevisan 1988): check
muller.basis: drawn from photos of the fossil: Hughes 1977, Plate 1, figs 1-4 (SEM). coarse reticulum of beaded (columellate) muri over a smooth floor; the lowest monocolpate tectate in the Warlingham section; size from the text (under 25 µm)
muller.cite: Hughes, N. F. 1977. Palaeo-succession of earliest angiosperm evolution. Botanical Review 43: 105-127. Plate 1, figs 1-4, p. 113.
